test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 7 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Dr. Purushottam Dadheech, who was awarded the prestigious Padma Shri award in 2020, is associated with which of the following dance forms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kathak**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Dr. Purushottam Dadheech is a **Kathak** dancer. He is a choreographer and educator of Indian classical dance and is known for his pioneering work in the field of Kathak.
 
• The oldest Kathak department which was formed in **1956** at Indira Kala Sangeet Vishwavidyalaya Public University located in Khairagarh, Purushottam Dadheech instated the **first Kathak syllabus** in 1961.
 
• He is the holder of the first Doctorate in Kathak Classical Dance and emphasizes the relevance of **Shastras** (Indian Ancient Dance treatises like Natyashastra and Nandikeshvara's Abhinaya Darpana) in the Kathak repertoire.
 
• He was awarded** Padma Shri**, the 4th highest civilian award in India.
 
• He is currently serving as the **Director** of the world’s first dedicated Kathak Research Centre at the Sri Sri University, Cuttack called Sri Sri Centre for Advanced Research in Kathak.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mohiniyattam**, is an Indian classical dance form that developed and remained popular in the state of Kerala. 
 
• **Kuchipudi** is one of the eight major Indian classical dances. It originates from a village named Kuchipudi in the Indian state of Andhra Pradesh.
 
• **Odissi**, also referred to as Orissa in old literature, is a major ancient Indian classical dance that origin in the Hindu temples of Odisha – an eastern coastal state of India.
